AddedRestriction.description: A hypothetical restriction overlay attached to a project's phase.
AddedRestriction.title: AddedRestriction

AttributeValue.description:
One attribute claim. ``value=None`` means unknown.

For CONFLICTING claims ``alternatives`` holds every competing value and
``value`` must be ``None`` until a review decision resolves it.
AttributeValue.title: AttributeValue

CoverageAssertion.description:
A reviewed claim that a region is completely modeled.

``scope='network'`` covers baseline pedestrian geometry. ``scope=<project id>``
says that project's restrictions within the region were reviewed.
CoverageAssertion.title: CoverageAssertion

Fact.description:
An unresolved fact that a route or result depends on.

``id`` is the key used for review prioritization and for explicit
``assumptions`` overrides.
Fact.title: Fact

Frame.description: Coordinate frame of a network. Metric claims need ``metric=True``.
Frame.title: Frame

GeometryOut.description: Everything needed to draw a scenario revision.
GeometryOut.title: GeometryOut

RestrictionWindowOverride.description: Keep a restriction's target edges open during an interval.
RestrictionWindowOverride.title: RestrictionWindowOverride

StateSpec.description: A selection of active phases (undated mode).
StateSpec.title: StateSpec

TargetRelation.description: A reviewed or proposed link between a restriction and an edge.
TargetRelation.title: TargetRelation

info.description: Local analysis of pedestrian access through construction phases. Results describe the reviewed model and its coverage, not real-world safety or legal compliance.
info.title: Ghost Routes API
